solution: The chapter's opening sentence is almost the stem verbatim: "the Industrial Finance Corporation of India was established in 1948 with the purpose of making available long term loans to industrial projects." Option (a) is the deliberate trap — the very next sentence assigns that purpose to a different body: "the Industrial Development Corporation was established in 1954 in order to bring about greater development of the industrial sector."

Under 'Automobile industry' the chapter says: "The automobile industry is called the 'sunrise sector' in India", supporting it with India's world-leading tractor output. Jute, cement and khadi/village industries each get their own paragraph in the chapter but none is given this label.

Under 'Textile industry': "According to the 'Textile Committee Act 1963', a Textile Committee has been established. This committee sets the quality standards for textiles manufactured for sale in the internal market as well as for export." Production and export of cloth are done by the industry itself, not the Committee; the chapter's own exercise 1(B) confirms the wrong pairing 'Textiles Committee - welfare of weavers' (weaver welfare belongs to the Mega cluster scheme).

Under 'Bicycle industry': "Bicycles are made in the States of Punjab and Tamil Nadu. The main centre of bicycle manufacturing in India is Ludhiana." Mumbai, Kolkata and Cochi appear in the chapter only as important ports for internal trade, not as bicycle centres.
